name: cinematic-web-studio
description: Create cinematic websites through reusable design, animation, media, 3D, performance, QA and export workflows. Requires a host with code execution and browser tools.

interface.longDescription: Skills and original runnable examples for creating, testing and exporting responsive cinematic websites. Includes real GLB interaction, scroll choreography and local assets. Uses tools provided by the host; it does not supply a cloud execution service or paid media generation.
defaultPrompt: Create a cinematic website for my product.
Build an interactive coffee website with a real 3D cup.

prompts: Create a premium interactive coffee website. Rotate the cup and move the camera on scroll. Support desktop and mobile.
Create a cinematic product page using lightweight CSS animation.
Export my website source as a ZIP without publishing it.

publication.release_notes: Initial skills-only release with original demos, GLB asset, local scaffold/export and browser QA.
